method: Opt-in rendered player. Uses saved Seed media, MissionController.Step and real FleetCombatSimulation events. No model requests or tuning-asset changes.
listening: Human audition and the 90-minute natural result route remain separate acceptance checks.

Live blast routes a Seed world clip
Fatal speaker stops all old cabin layers
Real results transition clears old audio

checks.detail: The technical result check uses one accelerated MissionController.Step without changing missionSeconds, targets or settings. Run the full timed and victory routes in the shipping player.

checks.name: Human mix and loop audition
checks.detail: Listen through every stage, flight layer, communication and long loop seam on speakers or headphones; signal checks cannot judge artistic quality.

checks.name: All four narrative stages and real-input attack
checks.detail: The player route proves opening and skip. Play the full four-stage Timeline and collide using controls to assess timing and event audio.
